purpose: Test whether Pygoscelis breeding sites that gained more summer-exposed terrestrial opportunity gained relative demographic weight within contemporaneous conspecific regional networks.
historical_outcome_exposure_note: MAPPPD count magnitudes were previously opened in a separate closed static-place lane. The present dynamic exposure-outcome association has not been used to choose the exposure metric, pixel thresholds, eligible sites, regions, species, or this model specification.

primary_exposure.definition: late-minus-early persistent-summer-exposed fraction divided by frozen epoch midpoint separation
primary_exposure.transform: standardize to mean 0 and SD 1 within species across the frozen primary units
primary_exposure.measurement_sensitivity: repeat the complete analysis with rate_p67_per_year; do not replace p50 based on result

primary_roster.source_rule: Intersect the 94 site x species units passing frozen full pixel QA with species x APBP-region groups containing at least five retained units and satisfying the inherited forcing-support criteria.

response_pipeline.observation_calibration: Reuse the frozen Paper 2 image-minus-direct log1p offset, accuracy-group variances and same-season inverse-variance collapse exactly as defined in contracts/PAPER2_REAL_OUTCOME_EXECUTION_V1.json.
response_pipeline.analysis_rows: One method-corrected collapsed log1p breeding-pair state per site x species x season.
response_pipeline.minimum_contemporaneous_support: Retain a species x region x season only when at least three frozen primary sites have an observed collapsed state in that season.

model.species_specific_formula: y_i,t = alpha_i + delta_region,t + beta_s * z(h_i) * tau_t + error_i,t
model.delta_region_t: species-specific APBP-region x season fixed effect
model.tau_t: (season - mean included season for that species) / 10; one unit equals one decade
model.beta_s: change in relative log1p breeding state per decade for a +1 SD difference in terrestrial-opportunity change rate
model.weighting: primary unweighted collapsed-state regression; frozen precision-weighted refit is a mandatory sensitivity, not a replacement
model.standard_errors: cluster-robust by physical site within species

inference.species_tests: Three prespecified one-sided tests beta_s > 0 for ADPE, CHPE and GEPE.

permutation.scheme: Within each species x frozen APBP region, permute the complete site-level exposure value among site time series; keep counts, observation structure, site identity and region-year states fixed.

inference.cross_species_summary: Report the three beta estimates, their signs and median beta descriptively. Do not assign a pooled paper-level p-value because physical sites can be shared among species.

secondary_H2.status: locked until H1 is computed and the marine metric itself is frozen
secondary_H2.allowed: One predeclared NSIDC sea-ice-access modifier only.
secondary_H2.forbidden: No broad environmental screen and no post-H1 search for a favorable marine covariate.

reason: The same-sensor late ETM+ route has zero support at all 44 long-term Adelie sites because post-2013 Landsat-7 Antarctic acquisition was not systematic.
The frozen Antarctic ETM+-OLI near-date overlap audit yielded zero scene pairs.
The 2026 Cape Hallett Landsat-8 validation demonstrates feasibility but also high 30-m commission/omission error and does not publish a complete transferable numeric classifier specification.
A_occupied_route.rule: Do not delay or redefine the H1 A_available-to-relative-use test in order to rescue A_occupied. A_occupied can return only through a separately validated measurement contract.

interpretation.positive: Within a species and regional temporal background, sites gaining terrestrial breeding opportunity gain relative breeding use through time.
interpretation.null: Changing terrestrial opportunity is not sufficient to explain relative redistribution at the tested spatial and temporal scale.
interpretation.negative: Sites gaining more terrestrial opportunity lose relative breeding use, a strong land-use decoupling pattern requiring separate mechanistic interpretation.

claim_boundaries: Relative breeding use is not literal occupied footprint.
Do not call APBP regions closed populations.
Do not interpret a null beta as evidence that nesting habitat never matters locally.
Do not reopen the closed static area-heterogeneity hypothesis.
Do not tune exposure thresholds, regional rosters or time windows after this dynamic association is computed.
next_gate: Pre-outcome recovery simulation of the exact two-way fixed-effect estimator on the frozen observation schedule.
